bio.text: I am a Full-Stack Web Developer. I know programming languages HTML, CSS, JS, PHP, frameworks Bootstrap and Laravel, and I am trained in Agile and Scrum methodologies. I am passionate about Graphics and oriented towards Frontend. I come from the Full-Stack Web Developer course at Aulab Hackademy and from university studies in Art, Cinema and Theatre. I am an artistic person with strong interpersonal skills, always looking for new challenges. I aspire to constantly improve myself.
